table.retrieve:
SELECT
	CustomerName = 'ALL CUSTOMERS', 
	aliasname=I.customicode, 
	itemname=I.name,
	price = Round(i.saleprice/i.packunits,2),
	stock=(select sum(godowndetail.currqty) from godowndetail where godowndetail.icode=I.icode and godowndetail.gcode in (:aa_gcode)),
	LastPurInvNo=(select max(sd.saleinvcode) from saledetail sd where sd.icode=I.icode and sd.gcode in (:aa_gcode)),
	purinvdate=(select max(sl.date) 	from saledetail sd, saleledger sl where sd.icode=I.icode and sd.saleinvcode=sl.saleinvcode and sd.gcode in (:aa_gcode)),
	Manufacturer=M.name
FROM  
	item I, manufacturer M
WHERE 
	:ai_custcode IS NULL AND
	I.manfcode IN (:aa_manfcode) and
	I.manfcode=M.manfcode and  
	I.icode NOT IN (select icode from saleledger, saledetail
						where date between :ar_StartDate and :ar_EndDate and
								saleledger.saleinvcode=saledetail.saleinvcode and saledetail.gcode in (:aa_gcode)) 
UNION ALL
SELECT 
	CustomerName = (SELECT AC.Name FROM Accounts AC WHERE AC.AccCode = :ai_custcode),
	aliasname=I.customicode,
	itemname=I.name,
	price = Round(i.saleprice/i.packunits,2),
	stock=(select sum(godowndetail.currqty) from godowndetail where godowndetail.icode=I.icode and godowndetail.gcode in (:aa_gcode)),
	LastPurInvNo=(select max(sd.saleinvcode) from saledetail sd, saleledger sl where sl.custcode = :ai_custcode and sd.icode=I.icode and sl.saleinvcode = sd.saleinvcode and sd.gcode in (:aa_gcode)),
	purinvdate=(select max(sl.date) 	from saledetail sd, saleledger sl where sd.icode=I.icode and sd.saleinvcode=sl.saleinvcode and sl.custcode = :ai_custcode and sd.gcode in (:aa_gcode)),
	Manufacturer=M.name
FROM  
	item I, manufacturer M
WHERE 
	:ai_custcode IS NOT NULL AND
	I.manfcode IN (:aa_manfcode) and
	I.manfcode=M.manfcode and  
	I.icode NOT IN (select icode from saleledger, saledetail
						where date between :ar_StartDate and :ar_EndDate and
								saleledger.saleinvcode=saledetail.saleinvcode and
								saleledger.custcode = :ai_custcode  and saledetail.gcode in (:aa_gcode)) 
ORDER BY 
	M.name,
	I.name
